_note: v2.9 07 (no-model lane, plumbing only, never sign-off): leaving the harbour fires the one transition and schedules Arin's echo; the next boundary lands it to plan 04's channel; drafting Arin puts the echo line in the applied private block and drafting the narrator does not; a rendered Arin reply settled through the generation hook writes an echo receipt and the author row reads offered; player mode stays clean; a swipe of the reply drops the receipt and the echo is offered again (once per chat: no second schedule). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v29-07-echoes.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); return { cleared: ctx.chat.length === 0 };

import_story.title: SO-V29-07 Echoes
import_story.description: Plan v2.9 07 no-model fixture: one echo for Arin one turn after the party leaves the harbour.

qualities.rubric: Did the party leave the harbour?

echoes.cue: the harbour fee you left unpaid has been noticed

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const LINE = 'If it fits, you may bring up: the harbour fee you left unpaid'; const chid = (name) => SillyTavern.getContext().characters.findIndex((character) => character.name === name); const rows = () => rt.getSnapshot().echoesAuthor?.rows ?? []; const receipts = () => (rt.getSnapshot().cuesAuthor?.receipts ?? []).filter((row) => row.source.kind === 'echo'); const block = (name) => { rt.onMemberDrafted(chid(name)); return rt.getAppliedEpistemicBlock(); }; globalThis.__e07 = { pause, until, LINE, chid, rows, receipts, block }; if (rows().length) throw new Error('an echo exists before its event'); return { rows: rows().length };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" The party walks out past the harbour gate.

steps.eval: const c = globalThis.__e07; await c.until(() => c.rows().some((row) => row.echoId === 'unpaid' && row.state === 'scheduled'), 10000, 'the echo scheduled'); if (c.block('Arin').includes(c.LINE)) throw new Error('the echo is offered on its source turn'); return { state: c.rows()[0].state };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" The road climbs into the hills.

steps.eval: const c = globalThis.__e07; await c.until(() => c.rows().some((row) => row.state === 'landed-to-channel'), 10000, 'the echo landed to channel'); await c.until(() => c.block('Arin').includes(c.LINE), 10000, 'the echo in the applied block of Arin'); if (c.block('DM Narrator').includes(c.LINE)) throw new Error('the narrator was handed the echo of Arin'); return { state: c.rows()[0].state };

steps.slash: /sendas name="Arin" Someone will want that fee.

steps.eval: const c = globalThis.__e07; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (!c.block('Arin').includes(c.LINE)) throw new Error('the echo is not staged for the reply'); rt.commitContinuityNote(true, id); await c.until(() => c.receipts().length === 1, 5000, 'an echo receipt'); await c.until(() => c.rows()[0]?.state === 'offered', 5000, 'the author row offered'); if (c.block('Arin').includes(c.LINE)) throw new Error('a spent echo was offered again'); return { receipt: c.receipts()[0].key, rows: c.rows().length };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__e07.pause(800); return { authorView: false };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await globalThis.__e07.pause(800); return { authorView: true };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; const reply = ctx.chat[last]; if (reply.is_user || reply.name !== 'Arin') throw new Error('the last message is not the reply of Arin'); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'The fee can wait.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipeable: last };

const c = globalThis.__e07; await c.until(() => c.receipts().length === 0, 15000, 'the swipe to drop the receipt'); await c.until(() => c.block('Arin').includes(c.LINE), 10000, 'the echo offered again after the swipe'); if (c.rows().length !== 1) throw new Error('the echo was scheduled twice: ' + c.rows().length); return { rows: c.rows().length };
